definition: the warmest season of the year
description: A hand tips a metal watering can over two terracotta pots of green herbs on a sunlit window sill, with trees in full leaf outside the open window. Cut to a close shot of a hand turning the knob on a sprinkler head standing in bright green grass. The sprinkler sends a tall jet of water arcing over a lawn with a stone fountain and flower beds behind. Then a girl reaches up to a hanging basket spilling pink and green foliage against a blue sky. Finally a man and two children run through the spray of a garden sprinkler, with a rainbow in the mist.
transcript: There you go. Drink up. Up here too.

taps.phrase: to reach up to the flowers
